lab_notes: Authority: preserve the supplied product model, canonical destinations, permissions, record states and monetary semantics. Frame Shift replaces the old visual specifications. Do not implement the old photographic UI mockup prompts, warm palette, 224px rail, portrait directory rows or blanket motion restrictions.

Direction selection is complete. The supplied eleven-criterion forecasts total Local Edit 88/110, Frame Shift 96/110 and Night Relay 89/110. Frame Shift wins on the combined earning, marketplace and media-review experience. These are design forecasts, not measured results; do not spend this sprint exploring another direction.

Build exactly five root prototypes: /design-lab/user-home, /design-lab/user-profile, /design-lab/business-home, /design-lab/business-content and /design-lab/public-home. Supporting dialogs and destination previews belong to these prototypes, not to a sixth application redesign.

Primary captures: User Home and User Profile at 390×844; Business Home and Business Content at 1440×900, plus 1440×1000 captures matching the supplied direction; Public Homepage at both 1440×900 and 390×844. Desktop pages use the same geometry at 900px and 1000px height: allow scrolling, never shrink the layout to fit.

All people, businesses, campaigns, work, qualifications, amounts and service records in this Lab are fictional. Show Personal · Demo or Business · Demo in authenticated identity selectors. Public demonstrations must have an adjacent, readable Demo product label. Generated scenes must be identified as illustrations. These labels are HTML, not watermarks inside source files.

Use a Lab-only fixture adapter and store. Never seed production, invoke live payment or approval handlers, connect accounts, send messages or use production signed media URLs. Each fixture includes demo:true, sourceAssetId, recordType and explicit permittedActions. Keep application, submission, offer, booking, proof, file, delivery, post, earning and payout states separate.

Freeze the demonstration clock at 2026-05-12T15:00:00Z. Use en-US formatting, USD cents and America/Chicago for these fixtures. Dates are absolute. Fixture financial breakdowns are explicit records, not calculations inferred by the UI. Currency formatting never truncates or substitutes zero while loading.

The default media package is intentionally still-image based: no source video or provider vehicle model has been supplied. Do not create a fake playable video from a poster, animate a photograph to imply footage, or substitute a generic GLB. Real product interaction recordings can be captured from implemented HTML. Optional source-video and model behavior is specified, but its controls appear only when the corresponding usable file exists.

Every image-model output is supporting imagery, never UI. Generate the assets listed below once, retain the originals, and reuse them only under the stated fixture relationships. No model-generated interface, device screen, financial record, verification badge, logo or installation proof is permitted.

Generate portraits first. Use portrait-maya-01 as the identity reference for Maya's working scenes. Generate public-filming-01 next and use its café materials as the visual reference for the Loopday imagery. Asset prompts are complete; reference images improve continuity but must not change the specified composition.

Produce three deterministic assets outside the image model: the TapMart SVG mark; a 1200×800 car-placement diagram with a highlighted rear-door zone; and demo-car-artwork.svg, a 1080×720 #F1D87A field with Spurroom Bikes in Archivo 700 at 104/112px and Keep moving. at 56/64px, both #151B23, inset 72px. The artwork is a supplied fictional campaign file, not an installed-ad preview.

Finish story-loopday-01 deterministically from its generated photographic base. At 1080×1920, add only Take a coffee break. as one centered line in Archivo 700, 76/84px, #F1D87A, at x=72, y=300, width=936. Rasterize the finished master once and use that same unmodified file for every Story presentation and download. Retain the photographic base separately. No TapMart money, status or controls enter the master.

After the authenticated screens render, capture capture-user-home-390 at 390×844, capture-business-home-1440 at 1440×1000 and capture-business-content-1440 at 1440×1000. Save lossless masters and WebP display derivatives under /design-lab/captures. These are browser outputs, not image-generation jobs. The public page imports these files; it must not recursively capture itself.

Public capture refresh is a build step, not a runtime service. Until captures exist, render the corresponding implemented components in an inert, clipped capture host at their logical dimensions. Once captured, replace the host with its browser-produced image without changing the reserved geometry.

Resolve links within the isolated Lab. The five main routes navigate normally. View work, View person, View car, Activity and Earnings open functional fixture-backed destination previews using the canonical destination mapping. Other retained destinations open a clearly labeled Destination preview with the destination name and Outside this five-screen prototype; never silently navigate to production or pretend an unimplemented action succeeded.

A simulated mutation returns a Promise from the Lab adapter after 250ms. This is explicitly a demo response, not backend progress. Keep the old state while pending, prevent duplicates, then update the fixture and announce the literal result. ?mutation=fail rejects that promise and retains the previous record. No optimistic approval, earnings or payout success.

Expose scenario selection on the /design-lab index and through URL parameters. Do not place a floating scenario toolbar over screenshot targets. Defaults are populated states. Screenshots must include the visible Demo identity/provenance but not developer controls.

Load Archivo variable 600–800 and IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600 with display:swap and metric-adjusted fallbacks. Use rem equivalents of the specified pixels. Target combined font transfer ≤100KB, phone initial transfer ≤600KB before optional media, route JS ≤180KB gzip where the stack permits, LCP ≤2.5s, CLS <0.1 and INP <200ms. These are targets to measure, not claims.

Use React, CSS Grid/Flexbox, CSS transitions, the Web Animations API, IntersectionObserver and standard video. Native View Transitions are optional enhancement for one selected media rectangle. No GSAP, scene framework, full-page WebGL background, generated environment or custom scrolling engine is required.

Review order: build and capture User Home before propagating components; then Profile and Business Home; then Content and its absence/error states; then public captures and storytelling. Final QA includes 320×568, 390×844, 768px, 1024px, 1280px and 1440px widths, 200% text enlargement, reduced motion, forced colors, keyboard operation and media failures.

All root screenshots must remain useful with JavaScript enhancement, video and 3D absent. No automatic income counters, fabricated analytics, follower leaderboards, testimonial evidence, future-feature tabs or decorative empty-state media.
